steps.label: Find and compare vendors
steps.note: Assumes a founder reviews three SOC 2 vendors for 15 minutes each. No human timing collected.

steps.label: Contact sales and request a call
steps.note: Assumes three minutes to fill one sales form with company details. Excludes waiting for a reply and scheduling delays. Vanta demo form inspected on 2026-10-11 at https://www.vanta.com/demo without submitting; inspection is not a measured human baseline.

steps.label: Sales call and quote
steps.note: Assumes one 30-minute sales call. This is a scenario assumption, not a vendor promise or observed duration.

steps.label: Negotiate and follow up
steps.note: Assumes 20 minutes of active work to review pricing and follow up once. Excludes time waiting for a response.

steps.label: Checkout
steps.note: Assumes three minutes for direct checkout and one minute with want-it. Both are estimates until a person times the same task.

kindNote: Illustrative estimate: 101 active human minutes per buyer directly versus one minute with want-it, or 100 estimated minutes saved. No observed human baseline has been collected. Waiting, agent call time and money are separate. This pilot uses fictional vendors and simulated payment holds. Vendor-side estimate assumes one 30-minute sales call per customer.
